# S15 texture sources

- S15_Water1_Source.jpg: Dylann Hendricks, "Blue Water Surface", Pexels photo 15184235.
  https://www.pexels.com/photo/blue-water-surface-15184235/
- S15_Water2_Source.png: Anna Romanova, "A Blue Body of Water", Pexels photo 14511164.
  https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-blue-body-of-water-14511164/
- The photo pages identify both photographs as free to use under the Pexels license:
  https://www.pexels.com/license/
- Lava: the existing project asset `Assets/ThirdParty/Textures/arcturian-lava-656827_1280.jpg`.
  The S15 review does not modify that original file or its import settings.

The three `*_Seamless.png` files are not included in this draft. The review launcher
creates them using the real RenderHub Seamless Texture Generator in the local
review project. Do not describe the unprocessed source photographs as RenderHub
outputs. The cloud browser could not run RenderHub because WebGL2 was unavailable.

https://www.renderhub.com/3d-toolbox/seamless-texture-generator
